swiftui: // Use the existing semantic tokens and a visible AI origin label; no AI color.
// Keep generated content in state while requests run.
// A source is a native Link; a disclosure opens source details without navigating.
// Cancel obsolete search tasks; only the latest request may replace the result.
uikit: // UIStackView composes the origin label, content, source links and explicit actions.
// Keep prior text during an async regenerate and retain it on errors.
// Use a real link control for each source; do not claim sources are verified.
appkit: // Compose an origin label and explicit actions from existing AppKit controls.
// NSPopover shows source details; a link navigates only after activation.
// Retain the current version until the caller supplies the regenerated result.
